derivation: Each valid capture is nonempty; four channel sums each <=4194304.
Each captured byte requires at most four Base64 bytes with independent padding.
Strict logical fields have bounded ASCII IDs/hash/channel strings and numeric tokens; 1024 envelope bytes includes conservative numeric/coordinate allowance.
A capture batch cannot include reserve/settle or multiple attempts. Control frames each contain one event.
This broad bound excludes arbitrary whitespace/duplicate keys: binary writer encoding is exact JSON.stringify output.
structural_bounds.limitation: The valid-semantic structural bound exceeds practical JS string/Buffer/RSS capacity. Writer payload materialization remains a capacity gap; no smaller limit silently added.

transport_invariants.justification: The next reader.read is issued only after awaiting the current one; cleanup awaits/cancels it and issues no new reads. One Promise yields at most one item. Overshoot aborts before another read.
transport_invariants.qualification: This bounds owned delivery count, not delivered item size, empty-read CPU, provider buffers or Fetch internal allocations.

counterexamples.metadata_method: Exact sum for the stated synthetic wire_delivery JSON format; no millions-of-write replay.

inequalities.raw_evidence: W + Q + C (conservative; Q and C not proven in bytes)
inequalities.transport: N_raw*M_delivery + M_pre + M_request + M_response + M_terminal <= available transport channel
inequalities.physical_storage: sum(4*ceil(b_i/3)) + logical envelopes + 144*transactions + JSON array separators + external artifacts + failure reserve
inequalities.run: sum over the unchanged 576 slots, including both D stages exactly once

decision: CAPACITY_NOT_CLOSED; no cap promotion, no new guard, no performance authorization, no live readiness
note: No performance measurements or new policy limits. Synthetic raw is storage-only, not a fabricated provider continuation.
